# labcheck

> labcheck is a no-key, local-first reproducibility auditor for notebook-heavy research and ML repositories.

It helps professors, research labs, ML/data founders, and OSS maintainers answer one question: if this repo is handed to a new student, reviewer, or engineer, can they actually rerun it?

## What labcheck Does

- Scans notebooks, Python scripts, manifests, README instructions, CI workflows, Dockerfiles, and simple data lineage.
- Flags reproducibility risks such as hidden notebook state, missing artifacts, unpinned dependencies, README drift, missing local helpers, nondeterministic ML code, unsafe remote artifacts, and CI gaps.
- Produces a reproducibility score, category scores, top risks, remediation steps, JSON, SARIF, Markdown, HTML, scorecards, issue drafts, badges, and audit packs.

## Safety Model

- No API keys are required.
- No hosted backend is required.
- The browser demo keeps selected files local in the browser tab and can fetch bounded public GitHub files client-side without tokens, prioritizing manifests, README files, CI workflows, notebooks, and Python source.
- The CLI performs deterministic static analysis and does not execute arbitrary project code by default.
- The privacy and safety model documents what is local-only, what calls GitHub directly, and what not to scan or publish.

## Good First Commands

```bash
python -m pip install -e .
labcheck doctor .
labcheck demo-repo
labcheck scorecard labcheck-demo-repo
labcheck scorecard examples/broken-repo
labcheck pack . --output-dir labcheck-audit --zip
labcheck demo-link https://github.com/owner/repo
labcheck demo-link https://github.com/owner/repo --format markdown --auto-audit
```
